validationNotes: Baseline c4bed588, clean worktree/index, nameKey 9320, no overlapping jobs. AGENTS and previous 358 passing checks inspected.

All 3 original full faces, basic stats, images (visually inspected), mana value 1 and restrictions verified. Exact-name filtering excluded 4 unrelated DJ search hits, so there are no reprints or duplicate names to count.

Rock uses existing g971 physical-target attack permission, including future attackers and summoning sickness only against the selected creature. QA36858 reproduced in both seats with actual fresh creatures. Initially tapped enemies and own creatures cannot be selected; intrinsic attack restrictions and Slowly remain; the permission expires at turn end and cannot follow a departed and newly entered incarnation.

DJ reuses the existing one-spell destruction-replacement payment with a printed creature-race filter for Great Mecha O. Tests cover a multirace Mecha O, an actual Mecha O twin, a second DJ, wrong spells/creatures, optional decline, ignored ability, bounce, non-destructive grave movement and simultaneous destruction reserving one physical hand card only once.

Jikuu Otoko reuses the NEO under-placement replacement with an explicit evolution-host variant. Ordinary evolution and evolved NEO are valid; unevolved NEO, enemy hosts and inactive sources are not. QA35947 reproduced with a Water evolution host and unrelated Dark Hedrian source, independent of evolution race requirements. Declining, later host movement, physical base identity and blocker/no-attack abilities verified.

52 focused tests, 192 replacement/destruction regressions, 73 attack/online regressions, total 317 passed. Legal forty-card seeded game preserves all UIDs and JSON legal actions; pending race-filtered payment and evolution host choices survive encrypted online storage and private-hand projection in both seats.

Initial 2 focused failures were fixture-only: a spell ignored by actual Genmu has no target choice; the helper now selects only when a real choice exists. Final focused module and all affected regressions pass.

check, audit, target9500 and baseline invariants pass. nameKey 9323, no duplicate names; existing 9320 definitions, IDs, images, pins, catalogue and saves unchanged. Historical incomplete whole-suite/long groups and prior individual/print deferrals retained. No push/publication/Netlify update.
